name: Paper Marker
tagline: Huge kinetic type on paper, marker notes that draw themselves, and hard switches to black.
description: Hand-made explainer style for product launches and one-idea pitches. Slamming heavy type on a warm paper canvas, red-pen arrows and circles that draw on, a yellow highlighter swipe, and hard cuts between paper and ink-black every 1.5–2 seconds.

display.usage: Kinetic headlines 190–250px, tracking -0.03em, two short lines max

body.usage: Marker notes, tags and CTA 64–80px, slightly rotated

transitions: hard cut between paper and ink-black (no fade)
no transitions inside a scene; everything enters on beats
textAnimations: line slam: y 90 + scale 1.18 → rest, 0.45s, 0.16s stagger
highlighter bar scaleX 0→1 behind one word, text flips to ink
SVG marker strokes draw on with pathLength=1 dashoffset 1→0
tags stamp in with scale 1.5 and a slight rotation

rhythm.notes: A new idea every 1.5–2s. Alternate paper and black scenes; each scene gets one slam plus one or two marker marks.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Two grounds only: warm paper #f4efe4 and ink-black #141210 with paper-coloured type. Lay a faint dot grain over everything (1px #1c1a17 dots at 10% on a 7px grid, layer at 0.35 opacity). Cut hard between paper and black every 1.5–2s, never crossfade.
- Headlines are Archivo Black 190–250px, tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.92, left-aligned at x≈160: one sentence per scene, split into two short lines. Lines slam in from y 90 / scale 1.18 with expo.out in 0.45s, 0.16s apart.
- Marker marks are wobbly hand-drawn SVG paths with round caps, pathLength="1" and stroke-dasharray 1; animate strokeDashoffset 1→0 with power2.inOut in 0.3–0.55s. Red pen #e2412b (8–16px) for arrows, circles and underlines; ink #1c1a17 (7px) for simple line sketches of the subject.
- Highlighter: a #ffd23f bar rotated about -1.5° scales X 0→1 behind one key word with power3.out in 0.35s, and the word flips to ink.
- Notes and tags are Caveat 700, 64–80px, rotated 1–5°: loose red-pen notes, or labels inside 5px ink-outlined tags (radius 22px) that stamp in from scale 1.5 with back.out(2.5), 0.18s apart. Notes carry concrete numbers or names, never abstractions.
- Each scene gets one slam plus one or two marks that arrive on beats; nothing drifts or moves inside a scene apart from these entrances.
- Optional motif: close on a name in 250px type with a 26px yellow marker underline drawing on and one blue-pen #2b59c3 Caveat line under it.
- Avoid photos, gradients, soft fades, glows and more than two headline lines at once.
example: The preview pitches a receipt-scanning app: lines like "Receipts pile up." slam onto paper, a sketched receipt and category tags get circled in red pen, and it ends on the app's wordmark. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
